title: Film Star Vijay Set to Become Tamil Nadu Chief Minister After VCK Support
detail: The Viduthalai Chiruthaigal Katchi (VCK), a Dalit rights party led by Thol. Thirumavalavan, extended unconditional support to Vijay's Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK), enabling the coalition to cross the majority mark (119 of 234 seats) in the Tamil Nadu assembly. Vijay — the actor-turned-politician whose real name is Joseph Vijay — was set to be sworn in as Tamil Nadu's Chief Minister, becoming one of the youngest and most unconventional CMs in Indian history. The TVK-VCK alliance marks a new chapter for Tamil politics, fusing mass cinema culture with Dalit political empowerment, displacing parties that have governed Tamil Nadu since 1967.

media.caption: Vijay set to become Tamil Nadu CM as VCK support takes TVK-led coalition past majority mark

title: New BJP Chief Minister Takes Oath in West Bengal as State Transitions Power
detail: West Bengal's new BJP Chief Minister took the oath of office in Kolkata, completing the transfer of power from the Trinamool Congress (TMC) government that had ruled the state since 2011 under Mamata Banerjee. The swearing-in ceremony was attended by PM Modi and senior BJP leaders. The transition marks a transformative political moment: West Bengal had been one of the last strongholds of non-BJP governance in large states. Security forces were deployed across the state amid lingering post-election tensions and continuing violence in multiple districts.

media.caption: West Bengal swears in BJP Chief Minister as India's political map shifts further toward BJP dominance

title: India-US Tech Cooperation Deepens at SelectUSA Investment Summit
detail: A senior US official urged India-US technology cooperation to avoid adversarial dependencies, emphasizing principles of openness in artificial intelligence and semiconductor supply chains at the SelectUSA Investment Summit. Indian businesses announced $1.1 billion in investments at the summit, underscoring the deepening economic partnership despite broader bilateral tensions. The tech cooperation push comes amid ongoing friction over tariffs and Trump administration remarks critical of India. The bilateral tech agenda — focused on AI, semiconductors, quantum computing, and secure supply chains — is seen as the most durable pillar of India-US relations even as trade tensions persist.

media.caption: US urges India-US tech cooperation with $1.1B in Indian investments pledged at SelectUSA Summit
